subject: HQ walkthrough & ops review — proposed dates and badging
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Christopher Yang <christopher.yang@orphic.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HQ walkthrough & ops review — proposed dates and badging

Hi Christopher —

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. Per our conversation, we’d like to host Orphic’s engineering and security leads for a walkthrough of our HQ and a short ops-level demo of the Redwood runtime. Proposed scope: brief product demo (45m), Q&A with infra/security (30m), and an ops sync on integration points (30m).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Apr 6: 10:00–12:00
- Wed, Apr 7: 14:00–16:00

Can you confirm which day works better for your team and who will attend? If neither works, suggest two alternative dates and I’ll coordinate with our scheduling team.

A couple logistics notes:
- I’ve attached a mutual NDA to sign via DocuSign — please sign when you have a chance so we can finalize visitor pre-clearance.
- Once we have the attendee list I'd send a visitor_badge_list.csv to our facilities team; we require full names, company, and driver license last 4 for badge printing.
- We’ll reserve conference room 2A and arrange an escort from reception; if you need AV (laptop HDMI, 2x mics), let me know.
- Parking: we can provide two visitor passes for the demo day — tell me vehicle make/model/plate if you need them.

Attached: Mutual_NDA_Orphic_2027.pdf (DocuSign)

Thanks — looking forward to hosting you.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Christopher Yang <christopher.yang@orphic.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HQ walkthrough & ops review — proposed dates and badging

Sergio —

Thanks for the invite. The team is excited, but Apr 6–7 conflict with our quarterly release freeze. Would Apr 8 work instead? Prefer morning (09:30–12:00) if possible.

Two asks from our side:
1) We need to meet briefly with your security lead (15–20m) to run through data handling and network boundaries. Can they join the on-site Q&A?
2) We can't sign the NDA through DocuSign immediately — procurement wants the PDF for legal review and prefers an emailed copy with the signing fields visible. Also need the expected deadline to return the signed NDA so we can prioritize.

Attendees (tentative): Christopher Yang (eng lead), Maya Patel (security), Nate Brooks (platform).

Appreciate if you can confirm alternative date and when we should expect visitor badge instructions.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HQ walkthrough & ops review — proposed dates and badging

Christopher —

Apr 8 morning works. I’ve moved the tentative hold on our side to:

Thu, Apr 8 · 09:30–12:00 PDT — Conference Room 2A (HQ)

We can absolutely include a short security touchpoint — looping in Aditya (internal infra/security PM) so he can join and prep. Per your procurement note, I’ve attached the PDF copy of the NDA (no DocuSign wrapper) for legal review plus the visitor_badge_list.csv template so you can forward to your team.

Requesting the signed NDA back by Thu, Mar 18 so our facilities team can complete pre-clearance. If procurement needs a different SLA, flag it and we’ll try to accommodate.

Logistics we will handle from our side: room 2A reserved (room_2A_reservation.ics attached), huddle table + HDMI dongle, two visitor parking passes (provide plate details by Apr 6), and an escort from reception. I’ll also order light catering (coffee + pastries) unless you prefer otherwise — let me know dietary restrictions.

Attachments: Mutual_NDA_Orphic_2027.pdf (PDF copy), visitor_badge_list.csv, room_2A_reservation.ics

Next steps:
- Christopher: confirm final attendee names + badge info by Apr 6
- Orphic legal: review & return signed NDA by Mar 18
- Aditya/Laura: I’ll coordinate AV/catering/parking following confirmation

Thanks,
—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
